caption: Wireless Network
description: The Wireless Network object describes an IEEE 802.11 wireless link: the identity of the network, the radio parameters it operates on, and the security negotiated for it.
name: wifi

band.description: The radio frequency band that the wireless link operates in, normalized to the caption of the band_id value. In the case of Other, it is defined by the event source.

band_id.description: The radio frequency band that the wireless link operates in.

1.caption: 2.4 GHz
1.description: The 2.4 GHz band, used by IEEE 802.11b, 802.11g, 802.11n, 802.11ax and 802.11be.

2.caption: 5 GHz
2.description: The 5 GHz band, used by IEEE 802.11a, 802.11n, 802.11ac, 802.11ax and 802.11be.

3.caption: 6 GHz
3.description: The 6 GHz band, used by IEEE 802.11ax and 802.11be.

4.caption: 60 GHz
4.description: The 60 GHz band, used by IEEE 802.11ad and 802.11ay.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The band is not mapped. See the band attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

channel_number.description: The channel number that the wireless link operates on.

cipher.caption: Cipher
cipher.description: The negotiated encryption cipher. For example: AES-CCMP, GCMP-256 or TKIP.

rssi.caption: RSSI
rssi.description: The Received Signal Strength Indicator reported for the wireless link, on the reporting vendor's own scale, which may be a relative index or a power level. For the received power in decibel-milliwatts, see signal_strength.

security_protocol.description: The Wi-Fi security protocol, normalized to the caption of the security_protocol_id value. In the case of Other, it is defined by the event source.

security_protocol_id.description: The authentication and key management suite that protects the wireless link.

1.caption: Open
1.description: The wireless network is unauthenticated and unencrypted.

2.caption: WEP
2.description: Wired Equivalent Privacy, the original IEEE 802.11 security mechanism, which uses a static shared key. It is deprecated.

3.caption: WPA
3.description: Wi-Fi Protected Access, which uses TKIP with a pre-shared key or IEEE 802.1X authentication.

4.caption: WPA2-Personal
4.description: Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 with a pre-shared key.

5.caption: WPA2-Enterprise
5.description: Wi-Fi Protected Access 2 with IEEE 802.1X authentication.

6.caption: WPA3-Personal
6.description: Wi-Fi Protected Access 3 with Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) in place of a pre-shared key handshake.

7.caption: WPA3-Enterprise
7.description: Wi-Fi Protected Access 3 with IEEE 802.1X authentication, including the optional 192-bit security mode.

8.caption: Opportunistic Wireless Encryption
8.description: Opportunistic Wireless Encryption (RFC 8110), which encrypts an open network without authentication.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The security protocol is not mapped. See the security_protocol attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

standard.caption: Standard
standard.description: The IEEE 802.11 amendment that the link operates under. For example: 802.11ax or 802.11ac.

references.description: IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN Medium Access Control and Physical Layer Specifications
